name: Bellisio Foods
old_description: Our passion is food. Bellisio Foods, Inc. is a fast growing company with a long history of providing quality, innovative food that meets and exceeds consumers’ needs. Bellisio Foods makes a strong investment in people who are committed to building dynamic and respected brands. We strive for excellence in all we do!
about:
Bellisio Foods operates from Jackson, Ohio, where it has built a long-standing presence in frozen food manufacturing. The company traces its quality roots to founder Jeno, whose personal taste tests established a standard that still guides production today. While the exact founding year is not publicly stated, the business describes itself as having a long history paired with fast-paced growth.

The company develops and produces frozen meals at a scale exceeding two million units per day across full-scale facilities that handle component processing, cooking, cooling, freezing, warehousing, and storage. A dedicated culinary center staffed by food scientists and chefs supports both proprietary brand development and custom formulations for private-label partners. Capabilities span research, product development, contract manufacturing, and quality assurance.

Bellisio serves the food and beverage sector, supplying retail and foodservice channels with branded and private-label frozen entrees. Its partner model focuses on commercializing new recipes from concept through high-volume production, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

The organization emphasizes continuous innovation and rigorous quality control as its differentiators, positioning itself as an expert in bringing high-quality frozen meals to market efficiently.
